_comment: Pilot: crosses arrival regime (heavy=current 0901 overload vs moderate=near-capacity) x machine-failure severity (off vs low), fixed at agv07_single (mid-envelope, non-deadlocking per deadlock-fix-verification memory). Tests whether the 7/9-rule convergence seen in results/0901 (arrival-only, heavy load) persists once there's queueing slack and/or disruptions for routing choice to exploit. Launch with run_generated.sh (NOT run_agv_sweep.sh -- its -disruption flag is dead code for -batchconfig-style runs per HeadlessBatchRunner; the inline 'stochastic' block below is the sole source of truth on this path).

configs._comment: Baseline: heavy load (matches results/0901 med_agv07_single), no failures.
configs.name: agv07_single_heavy_nofail

configs._comment: Heavy load + low-severity machine failures. Mean TTF ~2700s (~3x a typical episode segment).
configs.name: agv07_single_heavy_mflow

configs._comment: Moderate/near-capacity load, no failures. dynamicJobCap trimmed to 150 to bound episode length -- lower lambda means longer time-to-inject-all-arrivals, so cap is halved rather than left at 300. Not directly comparable in total job count to the heavy-load entries; comparisons are within-regime (rule vs rule, failure vs no-failure), not across regimes.
configs.name: agv07_single_moderate_nofail
